edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי יִרְמְיָהוּ בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּהוּ מִן־הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר בַּעֲנָתוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן׃

verses.english: to whom YHWH's word came in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלָיו בִּימֵי יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹן מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה בִּשְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְמָלְכוֹ׃

verses.english: It also came in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the completion of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, until Jerusalem's exile in the fifth month.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי יְהוֹיָקִים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה עַד־תֹּם עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְצִדְקִיָּהוּ בֶן־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה עַד־גְּלוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי׃

verses.english: YHWH's word came to me, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Before I formed you in the belly, I knew you; before you came out of the womb, I consecrated you. I appointed you a prophet to the nations.
verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם אצורך [אֶצָּרְךָ] בַבֶּטֶן יְדַעְתִּיךָ וּבְטֶרֶם תֵּצֵא מֵרֶחֶם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּיךָ נָבִיא לַגּוֹיִם נְתַתִּיךָ׃

verses.english: I said, Ah, Lord YHWH! Look, I do not know how to speak, for I am a youth.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה הִנֵּה לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי דַּבֵּר כִּי־נַעַר אָנֹכִי׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me, Do not say, I am a youth, for you will go to everyone to whom I send you, and you will speak everything I command you.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי אַל־תֹּאמַר נַעַר אָנֹכִי כִּי עַל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁלָחֲךָ תֵּלֵךְ וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוְּךָ תְּדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: Do not fear them, for I am with you to rescue you—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי־אִתְּךָ אֲנִי לְהַצִּלֶךָ נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH stretched out His hand and touched my mouth. YHWH said to me, Look, I have put My words in your mouth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוָה אֶת־יָדוֹ וַיַּגַּע עַל־פִּי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי דְבָרַי בְּפִיךָ׃

verses.english: See, today I have appointed you over the nations and kingdoms, to uproot and pull down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and plant.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה הִפְקַדְתִּיךָ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַל־הַגּוֹיִם וְעַל־הַמַּמְלָכוֹת לִנְתוֹשׁ וְלִנְתוֹץ וּלְהַאֲבִיד וְלַהֲרוֹס לִבְנוֹת וְלִנְטוֹעַ׃

verses.english: YHWH's word came to me, saying, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, I see an almond rod.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר מָה־אַתָּה רֹאֶה יִרְמְיָהוּ וָאֹמַר מַקֵּל שָׁקֵד אֲנִי רֹאֶה׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me, You have seen well, for I am watching over My word to perform it.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי הֵיטַבְתָּ לִרְאוֹת כִּי־שֹׁקֵד אֲנִי עַל־דְּבָרִי לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH's word came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? I said, I see a pot being fanned to boiling, its face tilted away from the north.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דְבַר־יְהוָה אֵלַי שֵׁנִית לֵאמֹר מָה אַתָּה רֹאֶה וָאֹמַר סִיר נָפוּחַ אֲנִי רֹאֶה וּפָנָיו מִפְּנֵי צָפוֹנָה׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me, From the north disaster will be opened upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָי מִצָּפוֹן תִּפָּתַח הָרָעָה עַל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: For look, I am calling all the clans of the northern kingdoms—YHWH's declaration. They will come and each set his throne at the entrance of Jerusalem's gates, against all her surrounding walls and against all Judah's cities.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנְנִי קֹרֵא לְכָל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹת מַמְלְכוֹת צָפוֹנָה נְאֻם־יְהוָה וּבָאוּ וְנָתְנוּ אִישׁ כִּסְאוֹ פֶּתַח שַׁעֲרֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְעַל כָּל־חוֹמֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב וְעַל כָּל־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: I will pronounce My judgments against them for all their evil, because they abandoned Me, burned offerings to other gods and bowed down to the work of their hands.
verses.hebrew: וְדִבַּרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטַי אוֹתָם עַל כָּל־רָעָתָם אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיְקַטְּרוּ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמַעֲשֵׂי יְדֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: But you, gird your waist, rise and speak to them everything I command you. Do not be dismayed before them, lest I dismay you before them.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה תֶּאְזֹר מָתְנֶיךָ וְקַמְתָּ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי אֲצַוֶּךָּ אַל־תֵּחַת מִפְּנֵיהֶם פֶּן־אֲחִתְּךָ לִפְנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: For look, today I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar and bronze walls against the whole land: against Judah's kings, her officials, her priests and the people of the land.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נְתַתִּיךָ הַיּוֹם לְעִיר מִבְצָר וּלְעַמּוּד בַּרְזֶל וּלְחֹמוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה לְשָׂרֶיהָ לְכֹהֲנֶיהָ וּלְעַם הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail over you, for I am with you—YHWH's declaration—to rescue you.
verses.hebrew: וְנִלְחֲמוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְלֹא־יוּכְלוּ לָךְ כִּי־אִתְּךָ אֲנִי נְאֻם־יְהוָה לְהַצִּילֶךָ׃

verses.english: Go and proclaim in Jerusalem's hearing: Thus says YHWH, I remember for you the steadfast love of your youth, the love of your bridal days, when you followed Me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
verses.hebrew: הָלֹךְ וְקָרָאתָ בְאָזְנֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה זָכַרְתִּי לָךְ חֶסֶד נְעוּרַיִךְ אַהֲבַת כְּלוּלֹתָיִךְ לֶכְתֵּךְ אַחֲרַי בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא זְרוּעָה׃

verses.english: Israel was holy to YHWH, the first of His harvest. All who devoured him incurred guilt; disaster came upon them—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: קֹדֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהוָה רֵאשִׁית תְּבוּאָתֹה כָּל־אֹכְלָיו יֶאְשָׁמוּ רָעָה תָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Hear YHWH's word, house of Jacob and all the clans of the house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ דְבַר־יְהוָה בֵּית יַעֲקֹב וְכָל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH: What wrong did your fathers find in Me, that they went far from Me, followed vapor and became vaporous?
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה מַה־מָּצְאוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בִּי עָוֶל כִּי רָחֲקוּ מֵעָלָי וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי הַהֶבֶל וַיֶּהְבָּלוּ׃

verses.english: They did not say, Where is YHWH, who brought us up from Egypt's land, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of steppe and pits, a land of drought and death-shadow, a land no one passed through and no human being inhabited?
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָמְרוּ אַיֵּה יְהוָה הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הַמּוֹלִיךְ אֹתָנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ עֲרָבָה וְשׁוּחָה בְּאֶרֶץ צִיָּה וְצַלְמָוֶת בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא־עָבַר בָּהּ אִישׁ וְלֹא־יָשַׁב אָדָם שָׁם׃

verses.english: I brought you into a fruitful land to eat its fruit and goodness, but you came and defiled My land and made My inheritance an abomination.
verses.hebrew: וָאָבִיא אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הַכַּרְמֶל לֶאֱכֹל פִּרְיָהּ וְטוּבָהּ וַתָּבֹאוּ וַתְּטַמְּאוּ אֶת־אַרְצִי וְנַחֲלָתִי שַׂמְתֶּם לְתוֹעֵבָה׃

verses.english: The priests did not say, Where is YHWH? Those handling the instruction did not know Me; the shepherds rebelled against Me; the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.
verses.hebrew: הַכֹּהֲנִים לֹא אָמְרוּ אַיֵּה יְהוָה וְתֹפְשֵׂי הַתּוֹרָה לֹא יְדָעוּנִי וְהָרֹעִים פָּשְׁעוּ בִי וְהַנְּבִיאִים נִבְּאוּ בַבַּעַל וְאַחֲרֵי לֹא־יוֹעִלוּ הָלָכוּ׃

verses.english: Therefore I will still contend with you—YHWH's declaration—and with your children's children I will contend.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן עֹד אָרִיב אִתְּכֶם נְאֻם־יְהוָה וְאֶת־בְּנֵי בְנֵיכֶם אָרִיב׃

verses.english: Cross over to the coastlands of Kittim and see; send to Kedar and consider carefully. See whether anything like this has happened.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עִבְרוּ אִיֵּי כִתִּיִּים וּרְאוּ וְקֵדָר שִׁלְחוּ וְהִתְבּוֹנְנוּ מְאֹד וּרְאוּ הֵן הָיְתָה כָּזֹאת׃

verses.english: Has a nation exchanged its gods, though they are not gods? Yet My people exchanged their glory for what does not profit.
verses.hebrew: הַהֵימִיר גּוֹי אֱלֹהִים וְהֵמָּה לֹא אֱלֹהִים וְעַמִּי הֵמִיר כְּבוֹדוֹ בְּלוֹא יוֹעִיל׃

verses.english: Be appalled at this, heavens; shudder and be utterly desolate—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁמּוּ שָׁמַיִם עַל־זֹאת וְשַׂעֲרוּ חָרְבוּ מְאֹד נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For My people committed two evils: they abandoned Me, the spring of living waters, to hew cisterns for themselves, broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שְׁתַּיִם רָעוֹת עָשָׂה עַמִּי אֹתִי עָזְבוּ מְקוֹר מַיִם חַיִּים לַחְצֹב לָהֶם בֹּארוֹת בֹּארֹת נִשְׁבָּרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָכִלוּ הַמָּיִם׃

verses.english: Is Israel a slave, or was he born in the house? Why has he become plunder?
verses.hebrew: הַעֶבֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם־יְלִיד בַּיִת הוּא מַדּוּעַ הָיָה לָבַז׃

verses.english: Young lions roar over him and raise their voice. They made his land a desolation; his cities were burned, without inhabitant.
verses.hebrew: עָלָיו יִשְׁאֲגוּ כְפִרִים נָתְנוּ קוֹלָם וַיָּשִׁיתוּ אַרְצוֹ לְשַׁמָּה עָרָיו נצתה [נִצְּתוּ] מִבְּלִי יֹשֵׁב׃

verses.english: Even the sons of Memphis and Tahpanhes have grazed the crown of your head.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־בְּנֵי־נֹף ותחפנס [וְתַחְפַּנְחֵס] יִרְעוּךְ קָדְקֹד׃

verses.english: Have you not brought this upon yourself by abandoning YHWH your God when He led you on the way?
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא־זֹאת תַּעֲשֶׂה־לָּךְ עָזְבֵךְ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהַיִךְ בְּעֵת מוֹלִיכֵךְ בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

verses.english: Now what have you to do with Egypt's road, to drink Shihor's water? And what have you to do with Assyria's road, to drink the River's water?
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַה־לָּךְ לְדֶרֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לִשְׁתּוֹת מֵי שִׁחוֹר וּמַה־לָּךְ לְדֶרֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לִשְׁתּוֹת מֵי נָהָר׃

verses.english: Your evil will discipline you, and your apostasies will rebuke you. Know and see that abandoning YHWH your God is evil and bitter, and that fear of Me is not in you—the declaration of the Lord YHWH of hosts.
verses.hebrew: תְּיַסְּרֵךְ רָעָתֵךְ וּמְשֻׁבוֹתַיִךְ תּוֹכִחֻךְ וּדְעִי וּרְאִי כִּי־רַע וָמָר עָזְבֵךְ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיִךְ וְלֹא פַחְדָּתִי אֵלַיִךְ נְאֻם־אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת׃

verses.english: For long ago I broke your yoke and tore apart your bonds, but you said, I will not serve. On every high hill and beneath every leafy tree you sprawled as a prostitute.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מֵעוֹלָם שָׁבַרְתִּי עֻלֵּךְ נִתַּקְתִּי מוֹסְרֹתַיִךְ וַתֹּאמְרִי לֹא אעבד [אֶעֱבוֹר] כִּי עַל־כָּל־גִּבְעָה גְּבֹהָה וְתַחַת כָּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן אַתְּ צֹעָה זֹנָה׃

verses.english: Yet I planted you as a choice vine, wholly genuine seed. How have you changed for Me into the degenerate shoots of a foreign vine?
verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי נְטַעְתִּיךְ שֹׂרֵק כֻּלֹּה זֶרַע אֱמֶת וְאֵיךְ נֶהְפַּכְתְּ לִי סוּרֵי הַגֶּפֶן נָכְרִיָּה׃

verses.english: Even if you wash with natron and use much cleansing alkali, your iniquity remains stained before Me—the declaration of the Lord YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־תְּכַבְּסִי בַּנֶּתֶר וְתַרְבִּי־לָךְ בֹּרִית נִכְתָּם עֲוֺנֵךְ לְפָנַי נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃

verses.english: How can you say, I am not defiled; I have not followed the Baals? Look at your way in the valley; know what you have done: a swift young she-camel entangling her ways,
verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ תֹּאמְרִי לֹא נִטְמֵאתִי אַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים לֹא הָלַכְתִּי רְאִי דַרְכֵּךְ בַּגַּיְא דְּעִי מֶה עָשִׂית בִּכְרָה קַלָּה מְשָׂרֶכֶת דְּרָכֶיהָ׃

verses.english: a wild donkey accustomed to the wilderness, sniffing the wind in her desire. Who can turn back her heat? All who seek her need not tire; in her month they will find her.
verses.hebrew: פֶּרֶה לִמֻּד מִדְבָּר בְּאַוַּת נפשו [נַפְשָׁהּ] שָׁאֲפָה רוּחַ תַּאֲנָתָהּ מִי יְשִׁיבֶנָּה כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיהָ לֹא יִיעָפוּ בְּחָדְשָׁהּ יִמְצָאוּנְהָ׃

verses.english: Keep your foot from going bare and your throat from thirst. But you said, It is hopeless! No, for I love strangers, and after them I will go.
verses.hebrew: מִנְעִי רַגְלֵךְ מִיָּחֵף וגורנך [וּגְרוֹנֵךְ] מִצִּמְאָה וַתֹּאמְרִי נוֹאָשׁ לוֹא כִּי־אָהַבְתִּי זָרִים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם אֵלֵךְ׃

verses.english: As a thief is ashamed when found, so the house of Israel is ashamed: they, their kings, their officials, their priests and their prophets.
verses.hebrew: כְּבֹשֶׁת גַּנָּב כִּי יִמָּצֵא כֵּן הֹבִישׁוּ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם שָׂרֵיהֶם וְכֹהֲנֵיהֶם וּנְבִיאֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They say to wood, You are my father, and to stone, You gave birth to me. They have turned their backs to Me, not their faces; yet in their trouble they say, Rise and save us!
verses.hebrew: אֹמְרִים לָעֵץ אָבִי אַתָּה וְלָאֶבֶן אַתְּ ילדתני [יְלִדְתָּנוּ] כִּי־פָנוּ אֵלַי עֹרֶף וְלֹא פָנִים וּבְעֵת רָעָתָם יֹאמְרוּ קוּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them rise, if they can save you in your trouble! For your gods are as numerous as your cities, Judah.
verses.hebrew: וְאַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לָּךְ יָקוּמוּ אִם־יוֹשִׁיעוּךָ בְּעֵת רָעָתֶךָ כִּי מִסְפַּר עָרֶיךָ הָיוּ אֱלֹהֶיךָ יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: Why do you contend with Me? All of you have rebelled against Me—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תָרִיבוּ אֵלָי כֻּלְּכֶם פְּשַׁעְתֶּם בִּי נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: In vain I struck your children; they accepted no discipline. Your sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion.
verses.hebrew: לַשָּׁוְא הִכֵּיתִי אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם מוּסָר לֹא לָקָחוּ אָכְלָה חַרְבְּכֶם נְבִיאֵיכֶם כְּאַרְיֵה מַשְׁחִית׃

verses.english: You of this generation, see YHWH's word! Have I been a wilderness to Israel, or a land of deep darkness? Why do My people say, We are free to roam; we will come to You no more?
verses.hebrew: הַדּוֹר אַתֶּם רְאוּ דְבַר־יְהוָה הֲמִדְבָּר הָיִיתִי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אִם אֶרֶץ מַאְפֵּלְיָה מַדּוּעַ אָמְרוּ עַמִּי רַדְנוּ לוֹא־נָבוֹא עוֹד אֵלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her bands? Yet My people have forgotten Me for days beyond counting.
verses.hebrew: הֲתִשְׁכַּח בְּתוּלָה עֶדְיָהּ כַּלָּה קִשֻּׁרֶיהָ וְעַמִּי שְׁכֵחוּנִי יָמִים אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have even taught wicked women your ways.
verses.hebrew: מַה־תֵּיטִבִי דַּרְכֵּךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ אַהֲבָה לָכֵן גַּם אֶת־הָרָעוֹת למדתי [לִמַּדְתְּ] אֶת־דְּרָכָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Even on your skirts was found the lifeblood of the innocent poor. You did not find them breaking in, but because of all these things—
verses.hebrew: גַּם בִּכְנָפַיִךְ נִמְצְאוּ דַּם נַפְשׁוֹת אֶבְיוֹנִים נְקִיִּים לֹא־בַמַּחְתֶּרֶת מְצָאתִים כִּי עַל־כָּל־אֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: yet you say, I am innocent; surely His anger has turned from me. Look, I am entering judgment with you because you say, I have not sinned.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמְרִי כִּי נִקֵּיתִי אַךְ שָׁב אַפּוֹ מִמֶּנִּי הִנְנִי נִשְׁפָּט אוֹתָךְ עַל־אָמְרֵךְ לֹא חָטָאתִי׃

verses.english: Why do you go about so much, changing your way? You will also be ashamed of Egypt, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
verses.hebrew: מַה־תֵּזְלִי מְאֹד לְשַׁנּוֹת אֶת־דַּרְכֵּךְ גַּם מִמִּצְרַיִם תֵּבוֹשִׁי כַּאֲשֶׁר־בֹּשְׁתְּ מֵאַשּׁוּר׃

verses.english: From this place too you will go out with your hands on your head, for YHWH has rejected those in whom you trust, and you will not prosper through them.
verses.hebrew: גַּם מֵאֵת זֶה תֵּצְאִי וְיָדַיִךְ עַל־רֹאשֵׁךְ כִּי־מָאַס יְהֹוָה בְּמִבְטַחַיִךְ וְלֹא תַצְלִיחִי לָהֶם׃

verses.english: Saying: If a man sends his wife away, and she leaves him and becomes another man's, will he return to her again? Would not that land be utterly polluted? Yet you have prostituted yourself with many lovers—and return to Me?—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: לֵאמֹר הֵן יְשַׁלַּח אִישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהָלְכָה מֵאִתּוֹ וְהָיְתָה לְאִישׁ־אַחֵר הֲיָשׁוּב אֵלֶיהָ עוֹד הֲלוֹא חָנוֹף תֶּחֱנַף הָאָרֶץ הַהִיא וְאַתְּ זָנִית רֵעִים רַבִּים וְשׁוֹב אֵלַי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

verses.english: Lift your eyes to the bare heights and see: where have you not been lain with? You sat for them beside the roads like an Arab in the wilderness. You polluted the land with your prostitution and your evil.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאִי־עֵינַיִךְ עַל־שְׁפָיִם וּרְאִי אֵיפֹה לֹא שגלת [שֻׁכַּבְתְּ] עַל־דְּרָכִים יָשַׁבְתְּ לָהֶם כַּעֲרָבִי בַּמִּדְבָּר וַתַּחֲנִיפִי אֶרֶץ בִּזְנוּתַיִךְ וּבְרָעָתֵךְ׃

verses.english: The showers were withheld, and there was no latter rain. Yet you had a prostitute's forehead; you refused to be ashamed.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּנְעוּ רְבִבִים וּמַלְקוֹשׁ לוֹא הָיָה וּמֵצַח אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה הָיָה לָךְ מֵאַנְתְּ הִכָּלֵם׃

verses.english: Have you not just now called to Me, My Father, You are the companion of my youth?
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא מֵעַתָּה קראתי [קָרָאת] לִי אָבִי אַלּוּף נְעֻרַי אָתָּה׃

verses.english: Will He keep anger forever? Will He preserve it always? Look, you have spoken, yet you have done evil and prevailed.
verses.hebrew: הֲיִנְטֹר לְעוֹלָם אִם־יִשְׁמֹר לָנֶצַח הִנֵּה דברתי [דִבַּרְתְּ] וַתַּעֲשִׂי הָרָעוֹת וַתּוּכָל׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me in the days of King Josiah, Have you seen what apostate Israel did? She went upon every high mountain and beneath every leafy tree and prostituted herself there.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי בִּימֵי יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ הֲ‍רָאִיתָ אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָה מְשֻׁבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל הֹלְכָה הִיא עַל־כָּל־הַר גָּבֹהַּ וְאֶל־תַּחַת כָּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן וַתִּזְנִי־שָׁם׃

verses.english: I said, After she has done all these things, she will return to Me. But she did not return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אַחֲרֵי עֲשׂוֹתָהּ אֶת־כָּל־אֵלֶּה אֵלַי תָּשׁוּב וְלֹא־שָׁבָה ותראה [וַתֵּרֶא] בָּגוֹדָה אֲחוֹתָהּ יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: I saw that, because apostate Israel committed adultery, I had sent her away and given her a certificate of divorce. Yet her treacherous sister Judah did not fear; she too went and prostituted herself.
verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא כִּי עַל־כָּל־אֹדוֹת אֲשֶׁר נִאֲפָה מְשֻׁבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלַּחְתִּיהָ וָאֶתֵּן אֶת־סֵפֶר כְּרִיתֻתֶיהָ אֵלֶיהָ וְלֹא יָרְאָה בֹּגֵדָה יְהוּדָה אֲחוֹתָהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתִּזֶן גַּם־הִיא׃

verses.english: Through the lightness of her prostitution she polluted the land and committed adultery with stone and wood.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה מִקֹּל זְנוּתָהּ וַתֶּחֱנַף אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַתִּנְאַף אֶת־הָאֶבֶן וְאֶת־הָעֵץ׃

verses.english: Yet despite all this, her treacherous sister Judah did not return to Me with her whole heart, but only in falsehood—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם־בְּכָל־זֹאת לֹא־שָׁבָה אֵלַי בָּגוֹדָה אֲחוֹתָהּ יְהוּדָה בְּכָל־לִבָּהּ כִּי אִם־בְּשֶׁקֶר נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me, Apostate Israel has proved herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי צִדְּקָה נַפְשָׁהּ מְשֻׁבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֹּגֵדָה יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: Go and proclaim these words toward the north: Return, apostate Israel—YHWH's declaration. I will not make My face fall upon you, for I am faithful—YHWH's declaration. I will not keep anger forever.
verses.hebrew: הָלֹךְ וְקָרָאתָ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה צָפוֹנָה וְאָמַרְתָּ שׁוּבָה מְשֻׁבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם־יְהוָה לוֹא־אַפִּיל פָּנַי בָּכֶם כִּי־חָסִיד אֲנִי נְאֻם־יְהוָה לֹא אֶטּוֹר לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Only acknowledge your iniquity: you rebelled against YHWH your God and scattered your ways to strangers beneath every leafy tree, and you did not obey My voice—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ דְּעִי עֲוֺנֵךְ כִּי בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהַיִךְ פָּשָׁעַתְּ וַתְּפַזְּרִי אֶת־דְּרָכַיִךְ לַזָּרִים תַּחַת כָּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן וּבְקוֹלִי לֹא־שְׁמַעְתֶּם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה׃

verses.english: Return, apostate children—YHWH's declaration—for I am your husband. I will take you, one from a city and two from a clan, and bring you to Zion.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבוּ בָנִים שׁוֹבָבִים נְאֻם־יְהוָה כִּי אָנֹכִי בָּעַלְתִּי בָכֶם וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אֶחָד מֵעִיר וּשְׁנַיִם מִמִּשְׁפָּחָה וְהֵבֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם צִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: I will give you shepherds according to My heart, and they will shepherd you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם רֹעִים כְּלִבִּי וְרָעוּ אֶתְכֶם דֵּעָה וְהַשְׂכֵּיל׃

verses.english: When you multiply and become fruitful in the land in those days—YHWH's declaration—they will no longer say, The ark of YHWH's covenant. It will not come to mind; they will not remember it or attend to it, and it will not be made again.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי תִרְבּוּ וּפְרִיתֶם בָּאָרֶץ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה נְאֻם־יְהוָה לֹא־יֹאמְרוּ עוֹד אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה וְלֹא יַעֲלֶה עַל־לֵב וְלֹא יִזְכְּרוּ־בוֹ וְלֹא יִפְקֹדוּ וְלֹא יֵעָשֶׂה עוֹד׃

verses.english: At that time they will call Jerusalem YHWH's throne, and all the nations will gather to her, to YHWH's name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer follow the stubbornness of their evil heart.
verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא יִקְרְאוּ לִירוּשָׁלִַם כִּסֵּא יְהוָה וְנִקְוּוּ אֵלֶיהָ כָל־הַגּוֹיִם לְשֵׁם יְהוָה לִירוּשָׁלִָם וְלֹא־יֵלְכוּ עוֹד אַחֲרֵי שְׁרִרוּת לִבָּם הָרָע׃

verses.english: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and together they will come from the northern land to the land I gave your fathers as an inheritance.
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה יֵלְכוּ בֵית־יְהוּדָה עַל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיָבֹאוּ יַחְדָּו מֵאֶרֶץ צָפוֹן עַל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִנְחַלְתִּי אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: I said, How I would place you among sons and give you a desirable land, the most splendid inheritance among the nations' hosts! I said, You will call Me My Father and not turn away from following Me.
verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי אָמַרְתִּי אֵיךְ אֲשִׁיתֵךְ בַּבָּנִים וְאֶתֶּן־לָךְ אֶרֶץ חֶמְדָּה נַחֲלַת צְבִי צִבְאוֹת גּוֹיִם וָאֹמַר אָבִי תקראו־[תִּקְרְאִי־] לִי וּמֵאַחֲרַי לֹא תשובו [תָשׁוּבִי׃]

verses.english: Surely, as a wife betrays her companion, so you have betrayed Me, house of Israel—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: אָכֵן בָּגְדָה אִשָּׁה מֵרֵעָהּ כֵּן בְּגַדְתֶּם בִּי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and supplications of Israel's children, because they twisted their way and forgot YHWH their God.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל עַל־שְׁפָיִים נִשְׁמָע בְּכִי תַחֲנוּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי הֶעֱוּוּ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם שָׁכְחוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Return, apostate children; I will heal your apostasies. Here we are, we have come to You, for You are YHWH our God.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבוּ בָּנִים שׁוֹבָבִים אֶרְפָּה מְשׁוּבֹתֵיכֶם הִנְנוּ אָתָנוּ לָךְ כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Surely the hills are a delusion, the tumult of the mountains; surely in YHWH our God is Israel's salvation.
verses.hebrew: אָכֵן לַשֶּׁקֶר מִגְּבָעוֹת הָמוֹן הָרִים אָכֵן בַּיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ תְּשׁוּעַת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Shame devoured the toil of our fathers from our youth: their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבֹּשֶׁת אָכְלָה אֶת־יְגִיעַ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מִנְּעוּרֵינוּ אֶת־צֹאנָם וְאֶת־בְּקָרָם אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Let us lie down in our shame and let our disgrace cover us, for we have sinned against YHWH our God, we and our fathers, from our youth to this day, and we have not obeyed YHWH our God's voice.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׁכְּבָה בְּבָשְׁתֵּנוּ וּתְכַסֵּנוּ כְּלִמָּתֵנוּ כִּי לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ חָטָאנוּ אֲנַחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ מִנְּעוּרֵינוּ וְעַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְלֹא שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּקוֹל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: If you return, Israel—YHWH's declaration—return to Me. If you remove your abominations from My presence and do not wander,
verses.hebrew: אִם־תָּשׁוּב יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם־יְהוָה אֵלַי תָּשׁוּב וְאִם־תָּסִיר שִׁקּוּצֶיךָ מִפָּנַי וְלֹא תָנוּד׃

verses.english: and swear, 'As YHWH lives,' in truth, justice, and righteousness, then nations will bless themselves in Him and glory in Him.
verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁבַּעְתָּ חַי־יְהוָה בֶּאֱמֶת בְּמִשְׁפָּט וּבִצְדָקָה וְהִתְבָּרְכוּ בוֹ גּוֹיִם וּבוֹ יִתְהַלָּלוּ׃

verses.english: For thus says YHWH to the men of Judah and Jerusalem: Break up your fallow ground, and do not sow among thorns.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כֹה אָמַר יְהֹוָה לְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה וְלִירוּשָׁלִַם נִירוּ לָכֶם נִיר וְאַל־תִּזְרְעוּ אֶל־קוֹצִים׃

verses.english: Circumcise yourselves to YHWH, and remove the foreskins of your hearts, men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, lest My fury go out like fire and burn with no one to quench it because of the evil of your deeds.
verses.hebrew: הִמֹּלוּ לַיהֹוָה וְהָסִרוּ עָרְלוֹת לְבַבְכֶם אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וְיֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָם פֶּן־תֵּצֵא כָאֵשׁ חֲמָתִי וּבָעֲרָה וְאֵין מְכַבֶּה מִפְּנֵי רֹעַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Declare in Judah and make it heard in Jerusalem; say: Sound a ram's horn in the land! Cry aloud and say: Gather, and let us enter the fortified cities!
verses.hebrew: הַגִּידוּ בִיהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם הַשְׁמִיעוּ וְאִמְרוּ ותקעו [תִּקְעוּ] שׁוֹפָר בָּאָרֶץ קִרְאוּ מַלְאוּ וְאִמְרוּ הֵאָסְפוּ וְנָבוֹאָה אֶל־עָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר׃

verses.english: Raise a signal toward Zion; flee for safety, do not stand still, for I am bringing disaster from the north and great destruction.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ־נֵס צִיּוֹנָה הָעִיזוּ אַל־תַּעֲמֹדוּ כִּי רָעָה אָנֹכִי מֵבִיא מִצָּפוֹן וְשֶׁבֶר גָּדוֹל׃

verses.english: A lion has gone up from his thicket; a destroyer of nations has set out and left his place to make your land a desolation. Your cities will be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
verses.hebrew: עָלָה אַרְיֵה מִסֻּבְּכוֹ וּמַשְׁחִית גּוֹיִם נָסַע יָצָא מִמְּקֹמוֹ לָשׂוּם אַרְצֵךְ לְשַׁמָּה עָרַיִךְ תִּצֶּינָה מֵאֵין יוֹשֵׁב׃

verses.english: For this, put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for YHWH's burning anger has not turned away from us.
verses.hebrew: עַל־זֹאת חִגְרוּ שַׂקִּים סִפְדוּ וְהֵילִילוּ כִּי לֹא־שָׁב חֲרוֹן אַף־יְהֹוָה מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: On that day—YHWH's declaration—the king's heart and the officials' heart will fail; the priests will be appalled and the prophets astounded.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא נְאֻם־יְהוָה יֹאבַד לֵב־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֵב הַשָּׂרִים וְנָשַׁמּוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַנְּבִיאִים יִתְמָהוּ׃

verses.english: Then I said: Ah, Lord YHWH! Surely You have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, 'You will have peace,' while the sword reaches to the life!
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אָכֵן הַשֵּׁא הִשֵּׁאתָ לָעָם הַזֶּה וְלִירוּשָׁלִַם לֵאמֹר שָׁלוֹם יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְנָגְעָה חֶרֶב עַד־הַנָּפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: At that time it will be said to this people and Jerusalem: A dry wind from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of My people, not to winnow and not to cleanse!
verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא יֵאָמֵר לָעָם־הַזֶּה וְלִירוּשָׁלִַם רוּחַ צַח שְׁפָיִים בַּמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ בַּת־עַמִּי לוֹא לִזְרוֹת וְלוֹא לְהָבַר׃

verses.english: A wind too full for these will come for Me; now I too will pronounce judgments against them.
verses.hebrew: רוּחַ מָלֵא מֵאֵלֶּה יָבוֹא לִי עַתָּה גַּם־אֲנִי אֲדַבֵּר מִשְׁפָּטִים אוֹתָם׃

verses.english: Look, he comes up like clouds, his chariots like a whirlwind, his horses swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are ruined!
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה כַּעֲנָנִים יַעֲלֶה וְכַסּוּפָה מַרְכְּבוֹתָיו קַלּוּ מִנְּשָׁרִים סוּסָיו אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי שֻׁדָּדְנוּ׃

verses.english: Wash your heart from evil, Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will your wicked schemes lodge within you?
verses.hebrew: כַּבְּסִי מֵרָעָה לִבֵּךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְמַעַן תִּוָּשֵׁעִי עַד־מָתַי תָּלִין בְּקִרְבֵּךְ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אוֹנֵךְ׃

verses.english: For a voice declares from Dan and announces trouble from the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.hebrew: כִּי קוֹל מַגִּיד מִדָּן וּמַשְׁמִיעַ אָוֶן מֵהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃

verses.english: Make it known to the nations; look, announce against Jerusalem: Watchers come from a distant land and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.
verses.hebrew: הַזְכִּירוּ לַגּוֹיִם הִנֵּה הַשְׁמִיעוּ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם נֹצְרִים בָּאִים מֵאֶרֶץ הַמֶּרְחָק וַיִּתְּנוּ עַל־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה קוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Like keepers of a field they are against her all around, because she rebelled against Me—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: כְּשֹׁמְרֵי שָׂדַי הָיוּ עָלֶיהָ מִסָּבִיב כִּי־אֹתִי מָרָתָה נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Your way and your deeds have brought these things upon you. This is your evil: how bitter it is, how it reaches to your heart!
verses.hebrew: דַּרְכֵּךְ וּמַעֲלָלַיִךְ עָשׂוֹ אֵלֶּה לָךְ זֹאת רָעָתֵךְ כִּי מָר כִּי נָגַע עַד־לִבֵּךְ׃

verses.english: My inward parts, my inward parts! I writhe! The walls of my heart! My heart roars within me; I cannot be silent, for you have heard, my soul, the sound of a ram's horn, the alarm of war.
verses.hebrew: מֵעַי מֵעַי אחולה [אוֹחִילָה] קִירוֹת לִבִּי הֹמֶה־לִּי לִבִּי לֹא אַחֲרִישׁ כִּי קוֹל שׁוֹפָר שמעתי [שָׁמַעַתְּ] נַפְשִׁי תְּרוּעַת מִלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: Disaster upon disaster is proclaimed, for the whole land is devastated. Suddenly my tents are devastated, in a moment my curtains.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁבֶר עַל־שֶׁבֶר נִקְרָא כִּי שֻׁדְּדָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ פִּתְאֹם שֻׁדְּדוּ אֹהָלַי רֶגַע יְרִיעֹתָי׃

verses.english: How long must I see a signal and hear the sound of a ram's horn?
verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי אֶרְאֶה־נֵּס אֶשְׁמְעָה קוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃

verses.english: For My people are foolish; they do not know Me. They are senseless children and have no understanding. They are wise at doing evil, but do not know how to do good.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֱוִיל עַמִּי אוֹתִי לֹא יָדָעוּ בָּנִים סְכָלִים הֵמָּה וְלֹא נְבוֹנִים הֵמָּה חֲכָמִים הֵמָּה לְהָרַע וּלְהֵיטִיב לֹא יָדָעוּ׃

verses.english: I looked at the earth, and look, waste and emptiness; and at the heavens, and they had no light.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְהִנֵּה־תֹהוּ וָבֹהוּ וְאֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵין אוֹרָם׃

verses.english: I looked at the mountains, and look, they were quaking, and all the hills swayed.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי הֶהָרִים וְהִנֵּה רֹעֲשִׁים וְכָל־הַגְּבָעוֹת הִתְקַלְקָלוּ׃

verses.english: I looked, and look, there was no human, and all the birds of the heavens had fled.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי וְהִנֵּה אֵין הָאָדָם וְכָל־עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם נָדָדוּ׃

verses.english: I looked, and look, the fruitful land was wilderness, and all its cities were pulled down before YHWH, before His burning anger.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי וְהִנֵּה הַכַּרְמֶל הַמִּדְבָּר וְכָל־עָרָיו נִתְּצוּ מִפְּנֵי יְהוָה מִפְּנֵי חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: For thus says YHWH: The whole land will be a desolation, yet I will not make a complete end.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה שְׁמָמָה תִהְיֶה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ וְכָלָה לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

verses.english: For this the earth will mourn and the heavens above grow dark, because I have spoken, I have planned, and I have not relented; I will not turn back from it.
verses.hebrew: עַל־זֹאת תֶּאֱבַל הָאָרֶץ וְקָדְרוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם מִמָּעַל עַל כִּי־דִבַּרְתִּי זַמֹּתִי וְלֹא נִחַמְתִּי וְלֹא־אָשׁוּב מִמֶּנָּה׃

verses.english: At the sound of horsemen and bowmen the whole city flees; they enter thickets and climb among rocks. Every city is abandoned, and no human dwells in them.
verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל פָּרָשׁ וְרֹמֵה קֶשֶׁת בֹּרַחַת כָּל־הָעִיר בָּאוּ בֶּעָבִים וּבַכֵּפִים עָלוּ כָּל־הָעִיר עֲזוּבָה וְאֵין־יוֹשֵׁב בָּהֵן אִישׁ׃

verses.english: And you, despoiled one, what will you do? Though you dress in scarlet, adorn yourself with golden ornaments, and enlarge your eyes with black paint, in vain you make yourself beautiful. Your lovers despise you; they seek your life.
verses.hebrew: ואתי [וְאַתְּ] שָׁדוּד מַה־תַּעֲשִׂי כִּי־תִלְבְּשִׁי שָׁנִי כִּי־תַעְדִּי עֲדִי־זָהָב כִּי־תִקְרְעִי בַפּוּךְ עֵינַיִךְ לַשָּׁוְא תִּתְיַפִּי מָאֲסוּ־בָךְ עֹגְבִים נַפְשֵׁךְ יְבַקֵּשׁוּ׃

verses.english: For I heard a voice like a woman in labor, anguish like one giving birth for the first time: the voice of the daughter of Zion, gasping, spreading her hands: Woe to me, for my soul faints before killers!
verses.hebrew: כִּי קוֹל כְּחוֹלָה שָׁמַעְתִּי צָרָה כְּמַבְכִּירָה קוֹל בַּת־צִיּוֹן תִּתְיַפֵּחַ תְּפָרֵשׂ כַּפֶּיהָ אוֹי־נָא לִי כִּי־עָיְפָה נַפְשִׁי לְהֹרְגִים׃

verses.english: Go about Jerusalem's streets; look, please, and learn, and search her squares. If you find a man, if there is one doing justice and seeking faithfulness, then I will forgive her.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹטְטוּ בְּחוּצוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם וּרְאוּ־נָא וּדְעוּ וּבַקְשׁוּ בִרְחוֹבוֹתֶיהָ אִם־תִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ אִם־יֵשׁ עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט מְבַקֵּשׁ אֱמוּנָה וְאֶסְלַח לָהּ׃

verses.english: Though they say, 'As YHWH lives,' surely they swear falsely.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם חַי־יְהֹוָה יֹאמֵרוּ לָכֵן לַשֶּׁקֶר יִשָּׁבֵעוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH, are not Your eyes toward faithfulness? You struck them, but they felt no pain; You consumed them, but they refused to accept correction. They made their faces harder than rock; they refused to return.
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה עֵינֶיךָ הֲלוֹא לֶאֱמוּנָה הִכִּיתָה אֹתָם וְלֹא־חָלוּ כִּלִּיתָם מֵאֲנוּ קַחַת מוּסָר חִזְּקוּ פְנֵיהֶם מִסֶּלַע מֵאֲנוּ לָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: Then I said: Surely these are the poor; they act foolishly because they do not know YHWH's way, their God's judgment.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי אַךְ־דַּלִּים הֵם נוֹאֲלוּ כִּי לֹא יָדְעוּ דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Let me go to the great and speak to them, for they know YHWH's way, their God's judgment. But they together have broken the yoke and torn the bonds.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֲכָה־לִּי אֶל־הַגְּדֹלִים וַאֲדַבְּרָה אוֹתָם כִּי הֵמָּה יָדְעוּ דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵיהֶם אַךְ הֵמָּה יַחְדָּו שָׁבְרוּ עֹל נִתְּקוּ מוֹסֵרוֹת׃

verses.english: Therefore a lion from the forest strikes them, a wolf of the steppes devastates them, and a leopard watches over their cities. Everyone leaving them will be torn apart, because their transgressions are many and their apostasies are strong.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן הִכָּם אַרְיֵה מִיַּעַר זְאֵב עֲרָבוֹת יְשָׁדְדֵם נָמֵר שֹׁקֵד עַל־עָרֵיהֶם כָּל־הַיּוֹצֵא מֵהֵנָּה יִטָּרֵף כִּי רַבּוּ פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם עָצְמוּ משבותיהם [מְשׁוּבוֹתֵיהֶם׃]

verses.english: How can I forgive you for this? Your sons abandoned Me and swore by what are not gods. I satisfied them, and they committed adultery and thronged a prostitute's house.
verses.hebrew: אֵי לָזֹאת אסלוח־[אֶסְלַח־] לָךְ בָּנַיִךְ עֲזָבוּנִי וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ בְּלֹא אֱלֹהִים וָאַשְׂבִּעַ אוֹתָם וַיִּנְאָפוּ וּבֵית זוֹנָה יִתְגֹּדָדוּ׃

verses.english: They were well-fed horses, roaming eagerly; each neighed after his neighbor's wife.
verses.hebrew: סוּסִים מְיֻזָּנִים מַשְׁכִּים הָיוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ יִצְהָלוּ׃

verses.english: Shall I not attend to these things?—YHWH's declaration. Shall not My soul take vengeance on a nation like this?
verses.hebrew: הַעַל־אֵלֶּה לוֹא־אֶפְקֹד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה וְאִם בְּגוֹי אֲשֶׁר־כָּזֶה לֹא תִתְנַקֵּם נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Go up among her vineyard rows and destroy, but do not make a complete end. Remove her tendrils, for they do not belong to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עֲלוּ בְשָׁרוֹתֶיהָ וְשַׁחֵתוּ וְכָלָה אַל־תַּעֲשׂוּ הָסִירוּ נְטִישׁוֹתֶיהָ כִּי לוֹא לַיהוָה הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have utterly betrayed Me—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בָגוֹד בָּגְדוּ בִּי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵית יְהוּדָה נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: They denied YHWH and said: It is not He; disaster will not come upon us, and we will not see sword or famine.
verses.hebrew: כִּחֲשׁוּ בַּיהוָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא־הוּא וְלֹא־תָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ רָעָה וְחֶרֶב וְרָעָב לוֹא נִרְאֶה׃

verses.english: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus let it be done to them!
verses.hebrew: וְהַנְּבִיאִים יִהְיוּ לְרוּחַ וְהַדִּבֵּר אֵין בָּהֶם כֹּה יֵעָשֶׂה לָהֶם׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says YHWH, God of hosts: Because you have spoken this word, look, I am making My words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will consume them.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת יַעַן דַּבֶּרְכֶם אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הִנְנִי נֹתֵן דְּבָרַי בְּפִיךָ לְאֵשׁ וְהָעָם הַזֶּה עֵצִים וַאֲכָלָתַם׃

verses.english: Look, I am bringing a nation against you from far away, house of Israel—YHWH's declaration. It is an enduring nation, an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know and whose speech you do not understand.
verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי מֵבִיא עֲלֵיכֶם גּוֹי מִמֶּרְחָק בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה גּוֹי אֵיתָן הוּא גּוֹי מֵעוֹלָם הוּא גּוֹי לֹא־תֵדַע לְשֹׁנוֹ וְלֹא תִשְׁמַע מַה־יְדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: Its quiver is like an open grave; all of them are warriors.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁפָּתוֹ כְּקֶבֶר פָּתוּחַ כֻּלָּם גִּבּוֹרִים׃

verses.english: It will consume your harvest and your bread; they will consume your sons and daughters. It will consume your flock and herd; it will consume your vine and fig tree. It will shatter with the sword your fortified cities in which you trust.
verses.hebrew: וְאָכַל קְצִירְךָ וְלַחְמֶךָ יֹאכְלוּ בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנוֹתֶיךָ יֹאכַל צֹאנְךָ וּבְקָרֶךָ יֹאכַל גַּפְנְךָ וּתְאֵנָתֶךָ יְרֹשֵׁשׁ עָרֵי מִבְצָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בּוֹטֵחַ בָּהֵנָּה בֶּחָרֶב׃

verses.english: Yet even in those days—YHWH's declaration—I will not make a complete end of you.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם בַּיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה לֹא־אֶעֱשֶׂה אִתְּכֶם כָּלָה׃

verses.english: When you say, 'Why has YHWH our God done all these things to us?' you shall say to them: As you abandoned Me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land not yours.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כִּי תֹאמְרוּ תַּחַת מֶה עָשָׂה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָנוּ אֶת־כָּל־אֵלֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עֲזַבְתֶּם אוֹתִי וַתַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהֵי נֵכָר בְּאַרְצְכֶם כֵּן תַּעַבְדוּ זָרִים בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא לָכֶם׃

verses.english: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and make it heard in Judah, saying:
verses.hebrew: הַגִּידוּ זֹאת בְּבֵית יַעֲקֹב וְהַשְׁמִיעוּהָ בִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Hear this, please, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ־נָא זֹאת עַם סָכָל וְאֵין לֵב עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ׃

verses.english: Will you not fear Me?—YHWH's declaration. Will you not tremble before Me, who set sand as the sea's boundary, a perpetual decree it cannot cross? Though its waves toss, they cannot prevail; though they roar, they cannot cross it.
verses.hebrew: הַאוֹתִי לֹא־תִירָאוּ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה אִם מִפָּנַי לֹא תָחִילוּ אֲשֶׁר־שַׂמְתִּי חוֹל גְּבוּל לַיָּם חָק־עוֹלָם וְלֹא יַעַבְרֶנְהוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ וְלֹא יוּכָלוּ וְהָמוּ גַלָּיו וְלֹא יַעַבְרֻנְהוּ׃

verses.english: But this people has a stubborn and rebellious heart; they turned aside and went away.
verses.hebrew: וְלָעָם הַזֶּה הָיָה לֵב סוֹרֵר וּמוֹרֶה סָרוּ וַיֵּלֵכוּ׃

verses.english: They did not say in their heart: Let us fear YHWH our God, who gives rain, the early and late rain in its season, who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אָמְרוּ בִלְבָבָם נִירָא נָא אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַנֹּתֵן גֶּשֶׁם וירה [יוֹרֶה] וּמַלְקוֹשׁ בְּעִתּוֹ שְׁבֻעוֹת חֻקּוֹת קָצִיר יִשְׁמָר־לָנוּ׃

verses.english: Your iniquities have turned these things away, and your sins have withheld the good from you.
verses.hebrew: עֲוֺנוֹתֵיכֶם הִטּוּ־אֵלֶּה וְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶם מָנְעוּ הַטּוֹב מִכֶּם׃

verses.english: For wicked people are found among My people; they watch like crouching bird-catchers. They set a destroying trap; they catch people.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נִמְצְאוּ בְעַמִּי רְשָׁעִים יָשׁוּר כְּשַׁךְ יְקוּשִׁים הִצִּיבוּ מַשְׁחִית אֲנָשִׁים יִלְכֹּדוּ׃

verses.english: Like a cage full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they have grown great and wealthy.
verses.hebrew: כִּכְלוּב מָלֵא עוֹף כֵּן בָּתֵּיהֶם מְלֵאִים מִרְמָה עַל־כֵּן גָּדְלוּ וַיַּעֲשִׁירוּ׃

verses.english: They have grown fat and sleek; they have even surpassed deeds of evil. They do not judge a case, the orphan's case, that it may prosper; and they do not judge the needy person's right.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְנוּ עָשְׁתוּ גַּם עָבְרוּ דִבְרֵי־רָע דִּין לֹא־דָנוּ דִּין יָתוֹם וְיַצְלִיחוּ וּמִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיוֹנִים לֹא שָׁפָטוּ׃

verses.english: Shall I not attend to these things?—YHWH's declaration. Shall not My soul take vengeance on a nation like this?
verses.hebrew: הַעַל־אֵלֶּה לֹא־אֶפְקֹד נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה אִם בְּגוֹי אֲשֶׁר־כָּזֶה לֹא תִתְנַקֵּם נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: An appalling and horrifying thing has happened in the land:
verses.hebrew: שַׁמָּה וְשַׁעֲרוּרָה נִהְיְתָה בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule at their hands, and My people love it so. But what will you do at its end?
verses.hebrew: הַנְּבִיאִים נִבְּאוּ־בַשֶּׁקֶר וְהַכֹּהֲנִים יִרְדּוּ עַל־יְדֵיהֶם וְעַמִּי אָהֲבוּ כֵן וּמַה־תַּעֲשׂוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָהּ׃

verses.english: Flee for safety, sons of Benjamin, from within Jerusalem! Sound a ram's horn in Tekoa, and raise a signal over Beth-haccherem, for disaster looks out from the north, and great destruction.
verses.hebrew: הָעִזוּ בְּנֵי בִניָמִן מִקֶּרֶב יְרוּשָׁלִַם וּבִתְקוֹעַ תִּקְעוּ שׁוֹפָר וְעַל־בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם שְׂאוּ מַשְׂאֵת כִּי רָעָה נִשְׁקְפָה מִצָּפוֹן וְשֶׁבֶר גָּדוֹל׃

verses.english: The lovely and pampered daughter of Zion I will silence.
verses.hebrew: הַנָּוָה וְהַמְּעֻנָּגָה דָּמִיתִי בַּת־צִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: Shepherds and their flocks will come to her; they will pitch tents against her all around, each grazing his own portion.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶיהָ יָבֹאוּ רֹעִים וְעֶדְרֵיהֶם תָּקְעוּ עָלֶיהָ אֹהָלִים סָבִיב רָעוּ אִישׁ אֶת־יָדוֹ׃

verses.english: Consecrate war against her! Rise, and let us go up at noon! Woe to us, for the day has turned, for evening's shadows stretch out!
verses.hebrew: קַדְּשׁוּ עָלֶיהָ מִלְחָמָה קוּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶה בַצָּהֳרָיִם אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי־פָנָה הַיּוֹם כִּי יִנָּטוּ צִלְלֵי־עָרֶב׃

verses.english: Rise, and let us go up by night and destroy her palaces!
verses.hebrew: קוּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶה בַלָּיְלָה וְנַשְׁחִיתָה אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: For thus says YHWH of hosts: Cut down trees and pour up a siege mound against Jerusalem. She is the city to be visited; all within her is oppression.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת כִּרְתוּ עֵצָה וְשִׁפְכוּ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם סֹלְלָה הִיא הָעִיר הָפְקַד כֻּלָּהּ עֹשֶׁק בְּקִרְבָּהּ׃

verses.english: As a well keeps its water fresh, so she keeps her evil fresh. Violence and devastation are heard in her; sickness and blows are continually before Me.
verses.hebrew: כְּהָקִיר בור [בַּיִר] מֵימֶיהָ כֵּן הֵקֵרָה רָעָתָהּ חָמָס וָשֹׁד יִשָּׁמַע בָּהּ עַל־פָּנַי תָּמִיד חֳלִי וּמַכָּה׃

verses.english: Accept correction, Jerusalem, lest My soul become estranged from you, lest I make you a desolation, a land uninhabited.
verses.hebrew: הִוָּסְרִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם פֶּן־תֵּקַע נַפְשִׁי מִמֵּךְ פֶּן־אֲשִׂימֵךְ שְׁמָמָה אֶרֶץ לוֹא נוֹשָׁבָה׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH of hosts: They will thoroughly glean Israel's remnant like a vine. Turn your hand back like a grape-gatherer over the tendrils.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת עוֹלֵל יְעוֹלְלוּ כַגֶּפֶן שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל הָשֵׁב יָדְךָ כְּבוֹצֵר עַל־סַלְסִלּוֹת׃

verses.english: To whom shall I speak and testify, so that they hear? Look, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot listen. Look, YHWH's word has become a reproach to them; they take no pleasure in it.
verses.hebrew: עַל־מִי אֲדַבְּרָה וְאָעִידָה וְיִשְׁמָעוּ הִנֵּה עֲרֵלָה אָזְנָם וְלֹא יוּכְלוּ לְהַקְשִׁיב הִנֵּה דְבַר־יְהוָה הָיָה לָהֶם לְחֶרְפָּה לֹא יַחְפְּצוּ־בוֹ׃

verses.english: But I am full of YHWH's fury; I am weary of holding it in. Pour it upon children in the street and upon the company of young men together, for man and woman alike will be captured, the old with those full of days.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת חֲמַת יְהוָה מָלֵאתִי נִלְאֵיתִי הָכִיל שְׁפֹךְ עַל־עוֹלָל בַּחוּץ וְעַל סוֹד בַּחוּרִים יַחְדָּו כִּי־גַם־אִישׁ עִם־אִשָּׁה יִלָּכֵדוּ זָקֵן עִם־מְלֵא יָמִים׃

verses.english: Their houses will pass to others, fields and wives together, for I will stretch out My hand against the land's inhabitants—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: וְנָסַבּוּ בָתֵּיהֶם לַאֲחֵרִים שָׂדוֹת וְנָשִׁים יַחְדָּו כִּי־אַטֶּה אֶת־יָדִי עַל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For from their least to their greatest, everyone is greedy for gain; and from prophet to priest, everyone practices falsehood.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִקְּטַנָּם וְעַד־גְּדוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בּוֹצֵעַ בָּצַע וּמִנָּבִיא וְעַד־כֹּהֵן כֻּלּוֹ עֹשֶׂה שָּׁקֶר׃

verses.english: They treated My people's fracture lightly, saying, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace.
verses.hebrew: וַיְרַפְּאוּ אֶת־שֶׁבֶר עַמִּי עַל־נְקַלָּה לֵאמֹר שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם וְאֵין שָׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: They were put to shame because they committed an abomination, yet they were not at all ashamed and did not know how to blush. Therefore they will fall among the fallen; when I attend to them, they will stumble, says YHWH.
verses.hebrew: הֹבִישׁוּ כִּי תוֹעֵבָה עָשׂוּ גַּם־בּוֹשׁ לֹא־יֵבוֹשׁוּ גַּם־הַכְלִים לֹא יָדָעוּ לָכֵן יִפְּלוּ בַנֹּפְלִים בְּעֵת־פְּקַדְתִּים יִכָּשְׁלוּ אָמַר יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH: Stand at the roads and see; ask for the ancient paths, where the good way is, and walk in it, and find rest for your souls. But they said, 'We will not walk.'
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה עִמְדוּ עַל־דְּרָכִים וּרְאוּ וְשַׁאֲלוּ לִנְתִבוֹת עוֹלָם אֵי־זֶה דֶרֶךְ הַטּוֹב וּלְכוּ־בָהּ וּמִצְאוּ מַרְגּוֹעַ לְנַפְשְׁכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נֵלֵךְ׃

verses.english: I set watchmen over you: Listen to the ram's horn's sound! But they said, 'We will not listen.'
verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִמֹתִי עֲלֵיכֶם צֹפִים הַקְשִׁיבוּ לְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא נַקְשִׁיב׃

verses.english: Therefore hear, nations, and know, assembly, what is among them.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן שִׁמְעוּ הַגּוֹיִם וּדְעִי עֵדָה אֶת־אֲשֶׁר־בָּם׃

verses.english: Hear, earth! Look, I am bringing disaster upon this people, the fruit of their thoughts, because they did not listen to My words, and they rejected My instruction.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעִי הָאָרֶץ הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־הָעָם הַזֶּה פְּרִי מַחְשְׁבוֹתָם כִּי עַל־דְּבָרַי לֹא הִקְשִׁיבוּ וְתוֹרָתִי וַיִּמְאֲסוּ־בָהּ׃

verses.english: Why should frankincense from Sheba come to Me, and sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices do not please Me.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה־זֶּה לִי לְבוֹנָה מִשְּׁבָא תָבוֹא וְקָנֶה הַטּוֹב מֵאֶרֶץ מֶרְחָק עֹלוֹתֵיכֶם לֹא לְרָצוֹן וְזִבְחֵיכֶם לֹא־עָרְבוּ לִי׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says YHWH: Look, I am placing stumbling blocks before this people, and fathers and sons together will stumble over them; neighbor and companion will perish.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנְנִי נֹתֵן אֶל־הָעָם הַזֶּה מִכְשֹׁלִים וְכָשְׁלוּ בָם אָבוֹת וּבָנִים יַחְדָּו שָׁכֵן וְרֵעוֹ יאבדו [וְאָבָדוּ׃]

verses.english: Thus says YHWH: Look, a people comes from the northern land, and a great nation is roused from the farthest parts of the earth.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנֵּה עַם בָּא מֵאֶרֶץ צָפוֹן וְגוֹי גָּדוֹל יֵעוֹר מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: They grasp bow and javelin; it is cruel, and they have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride horses, arrayed like a man for war against you, daughter of Zion.
verses.hebrew: קֶשֶׁת וְכִידוֹן יַחֲזִיקוּ אַכְזָרִי הוּא וְלֹא יְרַחֵמוּ קוֹלָם כַּיָּם יֶהֱמֶה וְעַל־סוּסִים יִרְכָּבוּ עָרוּךְ כְּאִישׁ לַמִּלְחָמָה עָלַיִךְ בַּת־צִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: We have heard its report; our hands grow slack. Distress has seized us, pain like a woman giving birth.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַעְנוּ אֶת־שָׁמְעוֹ רָפוּ יָדֵינוּ צָרָה הֶחֱזִיקַתְנוּ חִיל כַּיּוֹלֵדָה׃

verses.english: Do not go out into the field or walk on the road, for the enemy has a sword; terror is all around.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תצאי [תֵּצְאוּ] הַשָּׂדֶה וּבַדֶּרֶךְ אַל־תלכי [תֵּלֵכוּ] כִּי חֶרֶב לְאֹיֵב מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב׃

verses.english: Daughter of My people, put on sackcloth and roll in ashes. Make mourning for yourself as for an only child, bitter lamentation, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
verses.hebrew: בַּת־עַמִּי חִגְרִי־שָׂק וְהִתְפַּלְּשִׁי בָאֵפֶר אֵבֶל יָחִיד עֲשִׂי לָךְ מִסְפַּד תַּמְרוּרִים כִּי פִתְאֹם יָבֹא הַשֹּׁדֵד עָלֵינוּ׃

verses.english: I have made you an assayer among My people, a fortress, so that you may know and test their way.
verses.hebrew: בָּחוֹן נְתַתִּיךָ בְעַמִּי מִבְצָר וְתֵדַע וּבָחַנְתָּ אֶת־דַּרְכָּם׃

verses.english: All are utterly rebellious, going about with slander, bronze and iron; all of them act corruptly.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם סָרֵי סוֹרְרִים הֹלְכֵי רָכִיל נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶל כֻּלָּם מַשְׁחִיתִים הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: The bellows roar; from the fire the lead is exhausted. In vain the refiner refines, for the wicked are not separated out.
verses.hebrew: נָחַר מַפֻּחַ מאשתם [מֵאֵשׁ] [תַּם] עֹפָרֶת לַשָּׁוְא צָרַף צָרוֹף וְרָעִים לֹא נִתָּקוּ׃

verses.english: They call them rejected silver, for YHWH has rejected them.
verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף נִמְאָס קָרְאוּ לָהֶם כִּי־מָאַס יְהוָה בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: Stand in the gate of YHWH's house and proclaim this word there. Say: Hear YHWH's word, all Judah who enter these gates to bow down to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עֲמֹד בְּשַׁעַר בֵּית יְהוָה וְקָרָאתָ שָּׁם אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ שִׁמְעוּ דְבַר־יְהוָה כָּל־יְהוּדָה הַבָּאִים בַּשְּׁעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH of hosts, Israel's God: Make your ways and deeds good, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵיטִיבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶם וּמַעַלְלֵיכֶם וַאֲשַׁכְּנָה אֶתְכֶם בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: Do not trust deceptive words, saying, 'YHWH's temple, YHWH's temple, YHWH's temple are these!'
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ לָכֶם אֶל־דִּבְרֵי הַשֶּׁקֶר לֵאמֹר הֵיכַל יְהוָה הֵיכַל יְהוָה הֵיכַל יְהוָה הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: For if you truly make your ways and deeds good, if you truly execute justice between a man and his neighbor,
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־הֵיטֵיב תֵּיטִיבוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵיכֶם וְאֶת־מַעַלְלֵיכֶם אִם־עָשׂוֹ תַעֲשׂוּ מִשְׁפָּט בֵּין אִישׁ וּבֵין רֵעֵהוּ׃

verses.english: do not oppress the resident foreigner, orphan, or widow, do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not follow other gods to your own harm,
verses.hebrew: גֵּר יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה לֹא תַעֲשֹׁקוּ וְדָם נָקִי אַל־תִּשְׁפְּכוּ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לֹא תֵלְכוּ לְרַע לָכֶם׃

verses.english: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land I gave your fathers, from long ago and forever.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁכַּנְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶם לְמִן־עוֹלָם וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Look, you are trusting deceptive words that cannot benefit you.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַתֶּם בֹּטְחִים לָכֶם עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַשָּׁקֶר לְבִלְתִּי הוֹעִיל׃

verses.english: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn offerings to Baal, and follow other gods you have not known,
verses.hebrew: הֲגָנֹב רָצֹחַ וְנָאֹף וְהִשָּׁבֵעַ לַשֶּׁקֶר וְקַטֵּר לַבָּעַל וְהָלֹךְ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדַעְתֶּם׃

verses.english: then come and stand before Me in this house over which My name is called, and say, 'We are delivered'—in order to do all these abominations?
verses.hebrew: וּבָאתֶם וַעֲמַדְתֶּם לְפָנַי בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא־שְׁמִי עָלָיו וַאֲמַרְתֶּם נִצַּלְנוּ לְמַעַן עֲשׂוֹת אֵת כָּל־הַתּוֹעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: Has this house over which My name is called become a robbers' cave in your eyes? Look, I too have seen—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: הַמְעָרַת פָּרִצִים הָיָה הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא־שְׁמִי עָלָיו בְּעֵינֵיכֶם גַּם אָנֹכִי הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Go, please, to My place in Shiloh, where I first caused My name to dwell, and see what I did to it because of the evil of My people Israel.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לְכוּ־נָא אֶל־מְקוֹמִי אֲשֶׁר בְּשִׁילוֹ אֲשֶׁר שִׁכַּנְתִּי שְׁמִי שָׁם בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה וּרְאוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי לוֹ מִפְּנֵי רָעַת עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: And now, because you have done all these deeds—YHWH's declaration—and I spoke to you, rising early and speaking, but you did not hear, and I called you but you did not answer,
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יַעַן עֲשׂוֹתְכֶם אֶת־כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים הָאֵלֶּה נְאֻם־יְהוָה וָאֲדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם הַשְׁכֵּם וְדַבֵּר וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם וָאֶקְרָא אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא עֲנִיתֶם׃

verses.english: I will do to the house over which My name is called, in which you trust, and to the place I gave you and your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתִי לַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא־שְׁמִי עָלָיו אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בֹּטְחִים בּוֹ וְלַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתִּי לָכֶם וְלַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְשִׁלוֹ׃

verses.english: I will cast you away from My presence, as I cast away all your brothers, all Ephraim's offspring.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁלַכְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מֵעַל פָּנָי כַּאֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלַכְתִּי אֶת־כָּל־אֲחֵיכֶם אֵת כָּל־זֶרַע אֶפְרָיִם׃

verses.english: And you, do not pray on behalf of this people, do not lift up a cry or prayer for them, and do not press Me, for I am not listening to you.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אַל־תִּתְפַּלֵּל בְּעַד־הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאַל־תִּשָּׂא בַעֲדָם רִנָּה וּתְפִלָּה וְאַל־תִּפְגַּע־בִּי כִּי־אֵינֶנִּי שֹׁמֵעַ אֹתָךְ׃

verses.english: Do you not see what they are doing in Judah's cities and Jerusalem's streets?
verses.hebrew: הַאֵינְךָ רֹאֶה מָה הֵמָּה עֹשִׂים בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּבְחֻצוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: The children gather wood, the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven and to pour drink offerings to other gods, so as to provoke Me.
verses.hebrew: הַבָּנִים מְלַקְּטִים עֵצִים וְהָאָבוֹת מְבַעֲרִים אֶת־הָאֵשׁ וְהַנָּשִׁים לָשׁוֹת בָּצֵק לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּוָּנִים לִמְלֶכֶת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהַסֵּךְ נְסָכִים לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְמַעַן הַכְעִסֵנִי׃

verses.english: Is it Me they provoke?—YHWH's declaration. Is it not themselves, to the shame of their faces?
verses.hebrew: הַאֹתִי הֵם מַכְעִסִים נְאֻם־יְהוָה הֲלוֹא אֹתָם לְמַעַן בֹּשֶׁת פְּנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says Lord YHWH: Look, My anger and My fury are being poured upon this place, upon human and beast, upon the field's tree and the ground's fruit; it will burn and not be quenched.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה הִנֵּה אַפִּי וַחֲמָתִי נִתֶּכֶת אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה עַל־הָאָדָם וְעַל־הַבְּהֵמָה וְעַל־עֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה וְעַל־פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה וּבָעֲרָה וְלֹא תִכְבֶּה׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH of hosts, Israel's God: Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat meat!
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹלוֹתֵיכֶם סְפוּ עַל־זִבְחֵיכֶם וְאִכְלוּ בָשָׂר׃

verses.english: For I did not speak to your fathers or command them on the day I brought them out of Egypt's land concerning burnt offering and sacrifice.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־דִבַּרְתִּי אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם וְלֹא צִוִּיתִים בְּיוֹם הוציא [הוֹצִיאִי] אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עַל־דִּבְרֵי עוֹלָה וָזָבַח׃

verses.english: But this word I commanded them, saying: Hear My voice, and I will be your God and you will be My people; walk in all the way I command you, so that it may go well with you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה צִוִּיתִי אוֹתָם לֵאמֹר שִׁמְעוּ בְקוֹלִי וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ־לִי לְעָם וַהֲלַכְתֶּם בְּכָל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם לְמַעַן יִיטַב לָכֶם׃

verses.english: But they did not listen or incline their ear; they walked in counsels, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward rather than forward.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ וְלֹא־הִטּוּ אֶת־אָזְנָם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּמֹעֵצוֹת בִּשְׁרִרוּת לִבָּם הָרָע וַיִּהְיוּ לְאָחוֹר וְלֹא לְפָנִים׃

verses.english: From the day your fathers left Egypt's land until this day, I sent you all My servants the prophets, daily rising early and sending.
verses.hebrew: לְמִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וָאֶשְׁלַח אֲלֵיכֶם אֶת־כָּל־עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים יוֹם הַשְׁכֵּם וְשָׁלֹחַ׃

verses.english: But they did not listen to Me or incline their ear; they stiffened their neck and did worse than their fathers.
verses.hebrew: וְלוֹא שָׁמְעוּ אֵלַי וְלֹא הִטּוּ אֶת־אָזְנָם וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת־עָרְפָּם הֵרֵעוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם׃

verses.english: You shall say to them: This is the nation that did not obey the voice of YHWH its God and did not accept correction. Faithfulness has perished and been cut off from their mouth.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם זֶה הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לוֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו וְלֹא לָקְחוּ מוּסָר אָבְדָה הָאֱמוּנָה וְנִכְרְתָה מִפִּיהֶם׃

verses.english: You shall say to them: This is the nation that did not obey the voice of YHWH its God and did not accept correction. Faithfulness has perished and been cut off from their mouth.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם זֶה הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לוֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו וְלֹא לָקְחוּ מוּסָר אָבְדָה הָאֱמוּנָה וְנִכְרְתָה מִפִּיהֶם׃

verses.english: Cut off your consecrated hair and cast it away; lift a lament on the bare heights, for YHWH has rejected and abandoned the generation of His fury.
verses.hebrew: גָּזִּי נִזְרֵךְ וְהַשְׁלִיכִי וּשְׂאִי עַל־שְׁפָיִם קִינָה כִּי מָאַס יְהוָה וַיִּטֹּשׁ אֶת־דּוֹר עֶבְרָתוֹ׃

verses.english: For Judah's sons have done evil in My eyes—YHWH's declaration. They placed their detestable things in the house over which My name is called, to defile it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָשׂוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה הָרַע בְּעֵינַי נְאֻום־יְהוָה שָׂמוּ שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶם בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא־שְׁמִי עָלָיו לְטַמְּאוֹ׃

verses.english: They built Topheth's high places in the valley of Ben-hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in fire, which I did not command and which did not arise in My heart.
verses.hebrew: וּבָנוּ בָּמוֹת הַתֹּפֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּגֵיא בֶן־הִנֹּם לִשְׂרֹף אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא צִוִּיתִי וְלֹא עָלְתָה עַל־לִבִּי׃

verses.english: Therefore look, days are coming—YHWH's declaration—when it will no longer be called Topheth or the valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter; and they will bury in Topheth for lack of space.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנֵּה־יָמִים בָּאִים נְאֻם־יְהוָה וְלֹא־יֵאָמֵר עוֹד הַתֹּפֶת וְגֵיא בֶן־הִנֹּם כִּי אִם־גֵּיא הַהֲרֵגָה וְקָבְרוּ בְתֹפֶת מֵאֵין מָקוֹם׃

verses.english: This people's corpses will be food for the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth, with no one to frighten them away.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה נִבְלַת הָעָם הַזֶּה לְמַאֲכָל לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּלְבֶהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד׃

verses.english: I will make the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the voice of bridegroom and the voice of bride, cease from Judah's cities and Jerusalem's streets, for the land will become a ruin.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי מֵעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּמֵחֻצוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם קוֹל שָׂשׂוֹן וְקוֹל שִׂמְחָה קוֹל חָתָן וְקוֹל כַּלָּה כִּי לְחָרְבָּה תִּהְיֶה הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: At that time—YHWH's declaration—they will bring the bones of Judah's kings, the bones of its officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of Jerusalem's inhabitants out of their graves.
verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא נְאֻם־יְהוָה ויציאו [יוֹצִיאוּ] אֶת־עַצְמוֹת מַלְכֵי־יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת־שָׂרָיו וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת הַכֹּהֲנִים וְאֵת עַצְמוֹת הַנְּבִיאִים וְאֵת עַצְמוֹת יוֹשְׁבֵי־יְרוּשָׁלִָם מִקִּבְרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all heaven's host, which they loved, served, followed, sought, and bowed down to. They will not be gathered or buried; they will become dung on the ground's surface.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁטָחוּם לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵחַ וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲהֵבוּם וַאֲשֶׁר עֲבָדוּם וַאֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר דְּרָשׁוּם וַאֲשֶׁר הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם לֹא יֵאָסְפוּ וְלֹא יִקָּבֵרוּ לְדֹמֶן עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה יִהְיוּ׃

verses.english: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the remnant left of this evil family, in all the remaining places where I have driven them—declaration of YHWH of hosts.
verses.hebrew: וְנִבְחַר מָוֶת מֵחַיִּים לְכֹל הַשְּׁאֵרִית הַנִּשְׁאָרִים מִן־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת בְּכָל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת הַנִּשְׁאָרִים אֲשֶׁר הִדַּחְתִּים שָׁם נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת׃

verses.english: You shall say to them: Thus says YHWH: Do people fall and not rise? Does one turn away and not return?
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הֲיִפְּלוּ וְלֹא יָקוּמוּ אִם־יָשׁוּב וְלֹא יָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: Why has this people, Jerusalem, turned away in an enduring apostasy? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.
verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ שׁוֹבְבָה הָעָם הַזֶּה יְרוּשָׁלִַם מְשֻׁבָה נִצַּחַת הֶחֱזִיקוּ בַּתַּרְמִית מֵאֲנוּ לָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: I attended and listened; they do not speak rightly. No one repents of his evil, saying, 'What have I done?' Everyone turns to their course like a horse rushing into battle.
verses.hebrew: הִקְשַׁבְתִּי וָאֶשְׁמָע לוֹא־כֵן יְדַבֵּרוּ אֵין אִישׁ נִחָם עַל־רָעָתוֹ לֵאמֹר מֶה עָשִׂיתִי כֻּלֹּה שָׁב במרצותם [בִּמְרוּצָתָם] כְּסוּס שׁוֹטֵף בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: Even the stork in the heavens knows her appointed times, and the turtledove, swift, and crane keep the time of their coming; but My people do not know YHWH's judgment.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־חֲסִידָה בַשָּׁמַיִם יָדְעָה מוֹעֲדֶיהָ וְתֹר וסוס [וְסִיס] וְעָגוּר שָׁמְרוּ אֶת־עֵת בֹּאָנָה וְעַמִּי לֹא יָדְעוּ אֵת מִשְׁפַּט יְהוָה׃

verses.english: How can you say, 'We are wise, and YHWH's instruction is with us'? Surely, look, the scribes' lying pen has made it a lie.
verses.hebrew: אֵיכָה תֹאמְרוּ חֲכָמִים אֲנַחְנוּ וְתוֹרַת יְהוָה אִתָּנוּ אָכֵן הִנֵּה לַשֶּׁקֶר עָשָׂה עֵט שֶׁקֶר סֹפְרִים׃

verses.english: The wise are put to shame, dismayed and captured. Look, they rejected YHWH's word; what wisdom do they have?
verses.hebrew: הֹבִישׁוּ חֲכָמִים חַתּוּ וַיִּלָּכֵדוּ הִנֵּה בִדְבַר־יְהוָה מָאָסוּ וְחָכְמַת־מֶה לָהֶם׃

verses.english: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to possessors, for from small to great everyone is greedy for gain; from prophet to priest everyone practices falsehood.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֶתֵּן אֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶם לַאֲחֵרִים שְׂדוֹתֵיהֶם לְיוֹרְשִׁים כִּי מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל כֻּלֹּה בֹּצֵעַ בָּצַע מִנָּבִיא וְעַד־כֹּהֵן כֻּלֹּה עֹשֶׂה שָּׁקֶר׃

verses.english: I will utterly gather them away—YHWH's declaration. There are no grapes on the vine and no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf has withered; what I gave them will pass from them.
verses.hebrew: אָסֹף אֲסִיפֵם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה אֵין עֲנָבִים בַּגֶּפֶן וְאֵין תְּאֵנִים בַּתְּאֵנָה וְהֶעָלֶה נָבֵל וָאֶתֵּן לָהֶם יַעַבְרוּם׃

verses.english: Why are we sitting still? Gather, and let us enter the fortified cities and be silenced there, for YHWH our God has silenced us and made us drink poisoned water, because we sinned against YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עַל־מָה אֲנַחְנוּ יֹשְׁבִים הֵאָסְפוּ וְנָבוֹא אֶל־עָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר וְנִדְּמָה־שָּׁם כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הֲדִמָּנוּ וַיַּשְׁקֵנוּ מֵי־רֹאשׁ כִּי חָטָאנוּ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: We wait for peace, but there is no good; for a time of healing, but look, terror!
verses.hebrew: קַוֵּה לְשָׁלוֹם וְאֵין טוֹב לְעֵת מַרְפֵּה וְהִנֵּה בְעָתָה׃

verses.english: From Dan the snorting of his horses is heard; at the sound of his stallions' neighing the whole land quakes. They come and consume the land and its fullness, the city and those dwelling in it.
verses.hebrew: מִדָּן נִשְׁמַע נַחְרַת סוּסָיו מִקּוֹל מִצְהֲלוֹת אַבִּירָיו רָעֲשָׁה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבוֹאוּ וַיֹּאכְלוּ אֶרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ עִיר וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: For look, I am sending among you snakes, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנְנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ בָּכֶם נְחָשִׁים צִפְעֹנִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם לָחַשׁ וְנִשְּׁכוּ אֶתְכֶם נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: My comfort against sorrow—my heart is sick within me.
verses.hebrew: מַבְלִיגִיתִי עֲלֵי יָגוֹן עָלַי לִבִּי דַוָּי׃

verses.english: Look, the cry of the daughter of My people from a distant land: 'Is YHWH not in Zion? Is her King not in her?' Why have they provoked Me with their carved images, with foreign vapors?
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־קוֹל שַׁוְעַת בַּת־עַמִּי מֵאֶרֶץ מַרְחַקִּים הַיהוָה אֵין בְּצִיּוֹן אִם־מַלְכָּהּ אֵין בָּהּ מַדּוּעַ הִכְעִסוּנִי בִּפְסִלֵיהֶם בְּהַבְלֵי נֵכָר׃

verses.english: Harvest has passed, summer has ended, and we have not been saved.
verses.hebrew: עָבַר קָצִיר כָּלָה קָיִץ וַאֲנַחְנוּ לוֹא נוֹשָׁעְנוּ׃

verses.english: For the fracture of the daughter of My people I am broken; I mourn, and horror has seized me.
verses.hebrew: עַל־שֶׁבֶר בַּת־עַמִּי הָשְׁבָּרְתִּי קָדַרְתִּי שַׁמָּה הֶחֱזִקָתְנִי׃

verses.english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has healing not come up for the daughter of My people?
verses.hebrew: הַצֳרִי אֵין בְּגִלְעָד אִם־רֹפֵא אֵין שָׁם כִּי מַדּוּעַ לֹא עָלְתָה אֲרֻכַת בַּת־עַמִּי׃

verses.english: If only my head were water and my eye a fountain of tears, so that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of My people!
verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתֵּן רֹאשִׁי מַיִם וְעֵינִי מְקוֹר דִּמְעָה וְאֶבְכֶּה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה אֵת חַלְלֵי בַת־עַמִּי׃

verses.english: If only I had a travelers' lodging in the wilderness, so that I might leave my people and go away from them! For all of them are adulterers, a company of traitors.
verses.hebrew: מִי־יִתְּנֵנִי בַמִּדְבָּר מְלוֹן אֹרְחִים וְאֶעֶזְבָה אֶת־עַמִּי וְאֵלְכָה מֵאִתָּם כִּי כֻלָּם מְנָאֲפִים עֲצֶרֶת בֹּגְדִים׃

verses.english: They bend their tongue, their bow, for falsehood; not through faithfulness do they grow strong in the land, for they go from evil to evil and do not know Me—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּדְרְכוּ אֶת־לְשׁוֹנָם קַשְׁתָּם שֶׁקֶר וְלֹא לֶאֱמוּנָה גָּבְרוּ בָאָרֶץ כִּי מֵרָעָה אֶל־רָעָה יָצָאוּ וְאֹתִי לֹא־יָדָעוּ נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Each of you, guard against his neighbor, and do not trust any brother, for every brother utterly supplants, and every neighbor goes about slandering.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ מֵרֵעֵהוּ הִשָּׁמֵרוּ וְעַל־כָּל־אָח אַל־תִּבְטָחוּ כִּי כָל־אָח עָקוֹב יַעְקֹב וְכָל־רֵעַ רָכִיל יַהֲלֹךְ׃

verses.english: Each deceives his neighbor, and they do not speak truth. They taught their tongue to speak falsehood; they wear themselves out doing wrong.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ יְהָתֵלּוּ וֶאֱמֶת לֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ לִמְּדוּ לְשׁוֹנָם דַּבֶּר־שֶׁקֶר הַעֲוֵה נִלְאוּ׃

verses.english: Your dwelling is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know Me—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְתְּךָ בְּתוֹךְ מִרְמָה בְּמִרְמָה מֵאֲנוּ דַעַת־אוֹתִי נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says YHWH of hosts: Look, I will refine and test them, for how else can I act because of the daughter of My people?
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת הִנְנִי צוֹרְפָם וּבְחַנְתִּים כִּי־אֵיךְ אֶעֱשֶׂה מִפְּנֵי בַּת־עַמִּי׃

verses.english: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceit. With his mouth one speaks peace to his neighbor, but within him he sets an ambush.
verses.hebrew: חֵץ שוחט [שָׁחוּט] לְשׁוֹנָם מִרְמָה דִבֵּר בְּפִיו שָׁלוֹם אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ יְדַבֵּר וּבְקִרְבּוֹ יָשִׂים אָרְבּוֹ׃

verses.english: Shall I not attend to them for these things?—YHWH's declaration. Shall not My soul take vengeance on a nation like this?
verses.hebrew: הַעַל־אֵלֶּה לֹא־אֶפְקָד־בָּם נְאֻם־יְהוָה אִם בְּגוֹי אֲשֶׁר־כָּזֶה לֹא תִתְנַקֵּם נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: For the mountains I will lift weeping and lament, and for the wilderness pastures a dirge, for they are burned, with no one passing through, and the sound of livestock is not heard. From heaven's birds to beasts, they have fled and gone.
verses.hebrew: עַל־הֶהָרִים אֶשָּׂא בְכִי וָנֶהִי וְעַל־נְאוֹת מִדְבָּר קִינָה כִּי נִצְּתוּ מִבְּלִי־אִישׁ עֹבֵר וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ קוֹל מִקְנֶה מֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וְעַד־בְּהֵמָה נָדְדוּ הָלָכוּ׃

verses.english: I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling of jackals, and make Judah's cities a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְגַלִּים מְעוֹן תַּנִּים וְאֶת־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה אֶתֵּן שְׁמָמָה מִבְּלִי יוֹשֵׁב׃

verses.english: Who is the wise man who understands this, to whom YHWH's mouth has spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished, burned like the wilderness, with no one passing through?
verses.hebrew: מִי־הָאִישׁ הֶחָכָם וְיָבֵן אֶת־זֹאת וַאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר פִּי־יְהוָה אֵלָיו וְיַגִּדָהּ עַל־מָה אָבְדָה הָאָרֶץ נִצְּתָה כַמִּדְבָּר מִבְּלִי עֹבֵר׃

verses.english: YHWH said: Because they abandoned My instruction that I set before them, did not obey My voice, and did not walk in it,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה עַל־עָזְבָם אֶת־תּוֹרָתִי אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִפְנֵיהֶם וְלֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְקוֹלִי וְלֹא־הָלְכוּ בָהּ׃

verses.english: but walked after their heart's stubbornness and after the Baals, as their fathers taught them,
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי שְׁרִרוּת לִבָּם וְאַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים אֲשֶׁר לִמְּדוּם אֲבוֹתָם׃

verses.english: therefore thus says YHWH of hosts, Israel's God: Look, I will feed this people wormwood and make them drink poisoned water.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי מַאֲכִילָם אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה לַעֲנָה וְהִשְׁקִיתִים מֵי־רֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their fathers knew, and send the sword after them until I consume them.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲפִצוֹתִים בַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יָדְעוּ הֵמָּה וַאֲבוֹתָם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי אַחֲרֵיהֶם אֶת־הַחֶרֶב עַד כַּלּוֹתִי אוֹתָם׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH of hosts: Consider, and call the mourning women so that they come; send for the skilled women so that they come.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת הִתְבּוֹנְנוּ וְקִרְאוּ לַמְקוֹנְנוֹת וּתְבוֹאֶינָה וְאֶל־הַחֲכָמוֹת שִׁלְחוּ וְתָבוֹאנָה׃

verses.english: Let them hurry and lift a lament over us, so that our eyes run down with tears and our eyelids flow with water.
verses.hebrew: וּתְמַהֵרְנָה וְתִשֶּׂנָה עָלֵינוּ נֶהִי וְתֵרַדְנָה עֵינֵינוּ דִּמְעָה וְעַפְעַפֵּינוּ יִזְּלוּ־מָיִם׃

verses.english: For a sound of lament is heard from Zion: How we are devastated! We are greatly ashamed, for we have left the land, for they have thrown down our dwellings.
verses.hebrew: כִּי קוֹל נְהִי נִשְׁמַע מִצִּיּוֹן אֵיךְ שֻׁדָּדְנוּ בֹּשְׁנוּ מְאֹד כִּי־עָזַבְנוּ אָרֶץ כִּי הִשְׁלִיכוּ מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Hear YHWH's word, women, and let your ear receive His mouth's word; teach your daughters lament, and each woman her companion a dirge.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שְׁמַעְנָה נָשִׁים דְּבַר־יְהוָה וְתִקַּח אָזְנְכֶם דְּבַר־פִּיו וְלַמֵּדְנָה בְנוֹתֵיכֶם נֶהִי וְאִשָּׁה רְעוּתָהּ קִינָה׃

verses.english: For death has climbed through our windows and entered our palaces, to cut off children from the street and young men from the squares.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָלָה מָוֶת בְּחַלּוֹנֵינוּ בָּא בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֵינוּ לְהַכְרִית עוֹלָל מִחוּץ בַּחוּרִים מֵרְחֹבוֹת׃

verses.english: Speak: Thus is YHWH's declaration: Human corpses will fall like dung on the field's surface, like cut grain behind the reaper, with no one gathering.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר כֹּה נְאֻם־יְהוָה וְנָפְלָה נִבְלַת הָאָדָם כְּדֹמֶן עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וּכְעָמִיר מֵאַחֲרֵי הַקֹּצֵר וְאֵין מְאַסֵּף׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH: Let the wise not boast in his wisdom, the mighty not boast in his might, and the rich not boast in his wealth.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אַל־יִתְהַלֵּל חָכָם בְּחָכְמָתוֹ וְאַל־יִתְהַלֵּל הַגִּבּוֹר בִּגְבוּרָתוֹ אַל־יִתְהַלֵּל עָשִׁיר בְּעָשְׁרוֹ׃

verses.english: But let the one boasting boast in this: understanding and knowing Me, that I am YHWH, doing steadfast kindness, justice, and righteousness in the earth, for in these I delight—YHWH's declaration.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־בְּזֹאת יִתְהַלֵּל הַמִּתְהַלֵּל הַשְׂכֵּל וְיָדֹעַ אוֹתִי כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה עֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בָּאָרֶץ כִּי־בְאֵלֶּה חָפַצְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Look, days are coming—YHWH's declaration—when I will attend to all who are circumcised in uncircumcision:
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים נְאֻם־יְהוָה וּפָקַדְתִּי עַל־כָּל־מוּל בְּעָרְלָה׃

verses.english: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the sons of Ammon, Moab, and all who clip the hair at the temples, who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.
verses.hebrew: עַל־מִצְרַיִם וְעַל־יְהוּדָה וְעַל־אֱדוֹם וְעַל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וְעַל־מוֹאָב וְעַל כָּל־קְצוּצֵי פֵאָה הַיֹּשְׁבִים בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי כָל־הַגּוֹיִם עֲרֵלִים וְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל עַרְלֵי־לֵב׃

verses.english: Hear the word YHWH has spoken concerning you, house of Israel.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH: Do not learn the nations' way, and do not be dismayed at heaven's signs, because the nations are dismayed at them.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אֶל־דֶּרֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם אַל־תִּלְמָדוּ וּמֵאֹתוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם אַל־תֵּחָתּוּ כִּי־יֵחַתּוּ הַגּוֹיִם מֵהֵמָּה׃

verses.english: For the peoples' customs are vapor: one cuts wood from a forest, the work of a craftsman's hands with an adze.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חֻקּוֹת הָעַמִּים הֶבֶל הוּא כִּי־עֵץ מִיַּעַר כְּרָתוֹ מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי־חָרָשׁ בַּמַּעֲצָד׃

verses.english: One beautifies it with silver and gold; they fasten them with nails and hammers so that it does not totter.
verses.hebrew: בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב יְיַפֵּהוּ בְּמַסְמְרוֹת וּבְמַקָּבוֹת יְחַזְּקוּם וְלוֹא יָפִיק׃

verses.english: They are like a scarecrow in a cucumber field and cannot speak; they must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they cannot do harm, nor is doing good in them.
verses.hebrew: כְּתֹמֶר מִקְשָׁה הֵמָּה וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ נָשׂוֹא יִנָּשׂוּא כִּי לֹא יִצְעָדוּ אַל־תִּירְאוּ מֵהֶם כִּי־לֹא יָרֵעוּ וְגַם־הֵיטֵיב אֵין אוֹתָם׃

verses.english: Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz, a craftsman's work and a refiner's hands. Blue and purple are their clothing; all are the work of skilled people.
verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף מְרֻקָּע מִתַּרְשִׁישׁ יוּבָא וְזָהָב מֵאוּפָז מַעֲשֵׂה חָרָשׁ וִידֵי צוֹרֵף תְּכֵלֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן לְבוּשָׁם מַעֲשֵׂה חֲכָמִים כֻּלָּם׃

verses.english: Thus you shall say to them: The gods who did not make the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth and from beneath these heavens.
verses.hebrew: כִּדְנָה תֵּאמְרוּן לְהוֹם אֱלָהַיָּא דִּי־שְׁמַיָּא וְאַרְקָא לָא עֲבַדוּ יֵאבַדוּ מֵאַרְעָא וּמִן־תְּחוֹת שְׁמַיָּא אֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: He made the earth by His power, established the world by His wisdom, and by His understanding stretched out the heavens.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֵׂה אֶרֶץ בְּכֹחוֹ מֵכִין תֵּבֵל בְּחָכְמָתוֹ וּבִתְבוּנָתוֹ נָטָה שָׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: At His giving voice there is a roar of waters in the heavens; He raises clouds from the earth's end, makes lightning for rain, and brings wind from His storehouses.
verses.hebrew: לְקוֹל תִּתּוֹ הֲמוֹן מַיִם בַּשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעֲלֶה נְשִׂאִים מִקְצֵה ארץ [הָאָרֶץ] בְּרָקִים לַמָּטָר עָשָׂה וַיּוֹצֵא רוּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Every human becomes brutish, without knowledge; every refiner is put to shame by the carved image, for his cast object is a lie, and there is no breath in them.
verses.hebrew: נִבְעַר כָּל־אָדָם מִדַּעַת הֹבִישׁ כָּל־צוֹרֵף מִפָּסֶל כִּי שֶׁקֶר נִסְכּוֹ וְלֹא־רוּחַ בָּם׃

verses.english: They are vapor, a work of mockery; at the time of their visitation they will perish.
verses.hebrew: הֶבֶל הֵמָּה מַעֲשֵׂה תַּעְתֻּעִים בְּעֵת פְּקֻדָּתָם יֹאבֵדוּ׃

verses.english: Jacob's Portion is not like these, for He is the Former of everything, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance; YHWH of hosts is His name.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־כְאֵלֶּה חֵלֶק יַעֲקֹב כִּי־יוֹצֵר הַכֹּל הוּא וְיִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתוֹ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ׃

verses.english: Gather your bundle from the ground, you who dwell under siege.
verses.hebrew: אִסְפִּי מֵאֶרֶץ כִּנְעָתֵךְ ישבתי [יֹשֶׁבֶת] בַּמָּצוֹר׃

verses.english: For thus says YHWH: Look, this time I will sling out the land's inhabitants and press them hard, so that they may find.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנְנִי קוֹלֵעַ אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת וַהֲצֵרוֹתִי לָהֶם לְמַעַן יִמְצָאוּ׃

verses.english: Woe to me for my fracture! My wound is grievous. But I said: Surely this is sickness, and I must bear it.
verses.hebrew: אוֹי לִי עַל־שִׁבְרִי נַחְלָה מַכָּתִי וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי אַךְ זֶה חֳלִי וְאֶשָּׂאֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: My tent is devastated and all my cords snapped. My sons have left me and are no more; no one remains to stretch my tent or raise my curtains.
verses.hebrew: אָהֳלִי שֻׁדָּד וְכָל־מֵיתָרַי נִתָּקוּ בָּנַי יְצָאֻנִי וְאֵינָם אֵין־נֹטֶה עוֹד אָהֳלִי וּמֵקִים יְרִיעוֹתָי׃

verses.english: For the shepherds became brutish and did not seek YHWH; therefore they did not act wisely, and all their flock was scattered.
verses.hebrew: כִּי נִבְעֲרוּ הָרֹעִים וְאֶת־יְהוָה לֹא דָרָשׁוּ עַל־כֵּן לֹא הִשְׂכִּילוּ וְכָל־מַרְעִיתָם נָפוֹצָה׃

verses.english: A sound of news—look, it comes! A great shaking from the northern land, to make Judah's cities a desolation, a dwelling of jackals.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל שְׁמוּעָה הִנֵּה בָאָה וְרַעַשׁ גָּדוֹל מֵאֶרֶץ צָפוֹן לָשׂוּם אֶת־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה שְׁמָמָה מְעוֹן תַּנִּים׃

verses.english: I know, YHWH, that a human's way does not belong to him; it does not belong to a man who walks to establish his step.
verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי לֹא לָאָדָם דַּרְכּוֹ לֹא־לְאִישׁ הֹלֵךְ וְהָכִין אֶת־צַעֲדוֹ׃

verses.english: Correct me, YHWH, but with judgment, not in Your anger, lest You diminish me.
verses.hebrew: יַסְּרֵנִי יְהוָה אַךְ־בְּמִשְׁפָּט אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ פֶּן־תַּמְעִטֵנִי׃

verses.english: Pour Your fury upon the nations who do not know You and upon families who do not call on Your name, for they have consumed Jacob, consumed him and finished him, and devastated his habitation.
verses.hebrew: שְׁפֹךְ חֲמָתְךָ עַל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדָעוּךָ וְעַל מִשְׁפָּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּשִׁמְךָ לֹא קָרָאוּ כִּי־אָכְלוּ אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וַאֲכָלֻהוּ וַיְכַלֻּהוּ וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ הֵשַׁמּוּ׃

verses.english: The word that came to Jeremiah from YHWH, saying:
verses.hebrew: הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר הָיָה אֶל־יִרְמְיָהוּ מֵאֵת יְהוָה לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Hear the words of this covenant, and speak them to the men of Judah and Jerusalem's inhabitants.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת וְדִבַּרְתָּם אֶל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Say to them: Thus says YHWH, Israel's God: Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָרוּר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: which I commanded your fathers on the day I brought them out of Egypt's land, out of the iron furnace, saying: Hear My voice and do them, according to all I command you; you will be My people, and I will be your God,
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּיוֹם הוֹצִיאִי־אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם מִכּוּר הַבַּרְזֶל לֵאמֹר שִׁמְעוּ בְקוֹלִי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אוֹתָם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־אֲצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם וִהְיִיתֶם לִי לְעָם וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: so that I may establish the oath I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as on this day. And I answered and said: Amen, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת־הַשְּׁבוּעָה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה וָאַעַן וָאֹמַר אָמֵן יְהוָה׃
